scope: Opt-in native controller-port CPU qualification only; not a hardware test or a change to frozen simulator scores
required_explicit_inputs: --placement-release-config with measured explicit bounds and finish_after_release=true
planner_change: One explicit-profile predicate preserves request TCP/aperture; all default current-native paths retain previous feedback choice

synthetic_checks: required opt-in flags before fake driver factory
request versus delivery feedback, captured observation unchanged
pickup/loaded retention/release/FINISH state and command parity versus hash-pinned minimal adapter
accepted-open mailbox and fresh gripper gating
recovery/mask CPK invalidation and policy-opening passthrough
safety before same-tick finish and after measured hold

raw_fixture_provenance.scope: Saved teacher proposals/request proprio and contextual execution feedback; no images, model loading or raw-recording modification

metadata.episode: meta.json deploy_overrides.placement_controller_profile (ID, source SHA, effective veto/release, native timing limitations)
metadata.completion: stop.json completed_reason/completed_at_s and runtime placement_release diagnostics; independent of stronger stop/object success

limitations: No live repository or frozen source updated. No hardware, socket probe, model or GPU started.
Controller parity uses frozen saved plans and synthetic measured feedback, not physical execution qualification.
Native acknowledged gripper mailbox and stale-gripper checks may delay FINISH relative to ideal simulator acceptance.
Native finish_observation_s is explicit and differs from simulator hold through60s.

Historical optional veto predates live loaded-pad recovery exclusions and tactile phantom recovery; that difference is explicit and only applies under this opt-in. SafetyMonitor and driver guards remain unchanged.
Real wrist/tactile/RGB streams and normalizers retained; simulator gel/wrist proxies are not ported.
Physical TCP/release volume, sensors, UR3CB3 servo timing and retained optional limiter settings require lab qualification.
scope_note: Pinned files and pre-port unchanged checks cover this controller port only; separate reach-limiter extraction is not included or qualified.
